M00.titolo: The Infinite and the nothingness of the self
M00.sintesi: on the human plane he is the fool, the passive one who does not know where he is going, driven by impulses, bitten by the lynx of remorse and heading for the crocodile that returns everything to chaos. On the cosmic plane he is what lies beyond the intelligible: the Infinite that enfolds the finite, the bottomless abyss (Apsu, Ensoph) from which everything comes and into which everything returns. His last teaching is humility: to seek the Fool in oneself, to discover the emptiness of the small human personality.
M00.parole: Infinite, Absolute, Ensoph, abyss, nothingness, cosmogonic night, primordial substance, irrational; passivity, impulsiveness, unconsciousness, irresponsibility, alienation, madness, innocence, abandonment, mediumship
M00.bene: passivity, absolute abandonment, rest, giving up all resistance, nonchalance, innocence, irresponsibility; mediumistic gifts, instinctiveness; abstention: there is nothing to be done.
M00.male: nullity, inability to reason and to steer oneself, surrender to blind impulses, automatism, unconscious excess, extravagance; inescapable punishment of senseless acts, vain remorse, annihilation.

M01.sintesi: is the First Cause reflected in every principle of activity. In the universe he is God, the inspirer of all that is accomplished; in man he is the centre of initiative, perception, consciousness and will: the Self called to build the personality, because the individual has the task of making himself. Young, nimble, never still, he holds in potential all the tools of the Magus but still has to learn: he is the beginning of the active path that will be fulfilled in Strength (XI).
M01.parole: unity, cause, initiative, thinking subject, consciousness, autonomy, presence of mind, dexterity, skill, diplomacy, eloquence, persuasion; in the negative cunning, intrigue, charlatanism, lying
M01.bene: dexterity, skill, diplomatic finesse, eloquence, the art of convincing, a lively mind, quick intelligence, a businessman always on the move.
M01.male: skilled persuader, manipulator, illusionist, schemer, climber, political operator, charlatan, impostor, liar, swindler, exploiter of the naive; vain agitation, lack of scruples.
M01.astro: Mercury, for good and for ill.

M02.sintesi: is Isis, the great priestess of the deep night that the human mind cannot penetrate without her help. Seated, motionless, silent, impenetrable, hieratic, she is the opposite of the restless Magician. She holds the book of secrets half open and keeps two keys, of gold and of silver: to divine hidden things one must join a strict logic to an exquisite impressionability. With her we enter the Binary, the realm of distinction, from which all knowledge is born.
M02.parole: mystery, intuition, gnosis, divination, faith, esotericism, silence, discretion, meditation, patience, piety; in the negative dissimulation, hypocrisy, inertia, bigotry, fanaticism
M02.bene: reserve, discretion, silence, meditation, faith, trusting expectation, patience, religious feeling, resignation, hidden things turning favourable, necessary inertia.
M02.male: hidden intentions, dissimulation, hypocrisy, help awaited in vain, inaction, laziness, bigotry, grudges, hostile or indifferent dispositions, mystical absorption.

M03.sintesi: a sovereign shining with light, she is the creative Intelligence, mother of forms, images and ideas. The Immaculate Virgin of the Christians, the Venus Urania of the Greeks born radiant from the waves of the chaotic ocean, the Queen of Heaven hovering above all contingency. She rules the changing sublunary world, resting her foot on a moon with its horns turned down. She is the region of archetypes, of the pure ideas according to which everything is created. She draws the mind out of the mental chaos in which the night of the High Priestess would leave it: with the Three, light appears.
M03.parole: understanding, conception, ideality, discernment, observation, study, inductive science, education, grace, affability, gentleness that governs, civilisation, abundance, fertility; in the negative vanity, posing, frivolity, luxury, coquetry
M03.bene: understanding, intelligence, education, charm, affability, elegance, distinction, courtesy, rule exercised through the mind, abundance, wealth, civilisation.
M03.male: affectation, posing, coquetry, vanity, pretension, disdain, frivolity, luxury, prodigality, susceptibility to flattery, lack of refinement, nouveau-riche manners.

M04.sintesi: after the luminous Empress comes the dark sovereign of the underworld: a Pluto imprisoned at the centre of things, the vital Fire that burns at the expense of the alchemists' Sulphur. He is the Prince of this world, the rightful lord of all that is bodily: the Demiurge, the Great Architect, the inner god who builds, animates and governs organisms. He sits on the only throne that cannot be overturned, the perfect cube. He is energy, right, will, mathematical certainty.
M04.parole: energy, power, right, will, fixity, concentration, certainty, deduction, constancy, firmness, rigour, exactness, equity, positivism, protection; in the negative stubbornness, harshness, tyranny, absolutism, lack of intuition
M04.bene: right, rigour, certainty, fixity, realisation, persevering energy, unshakeable will, carrying out what has been decided, a powerful protector.
M04.male: tenacious opposition, obstinacy, hostile bias, stubborn adversary, an enterprise thwarted, an adverse government, great risk of failure, tyranny, absolutism.

M05.sintesi: after the grim face of the Emperor, the jovial face of the Pope, full of gentleness: an indulgent pontiff who understands everything, with a well-kept white beard, the age at which calmed passions leave the intelligence all its lucidity. He establishes dogma, answers the anguished questions of the faithful, formulates teaching for two kinds of believers. He is the centre of the cross, the rose blossoming in its heart, the pentagram of man the mediator: the quintessence that brings the four Elements back to unity. His power is spiritual, and rests on knowing how to restrain and on obeying in order to be obeyed.
M05.parole: duty, moral law, conscience, teaching, moral authority, religion, metaphysics, esotericism, benevolence, indulgence, forgiveness, quintessence; in the negative dogmatism, narrow moralism, pedantry, sententiousness
M05.bene: moral authority, social priesthood, respect for propriety, respectability, teaching, even-handed advice, benevolence, indulgent generosity, forgiveness, meekness.
M05.male: sententious pontiff, narrow moralist, dogmatic metaphysician, overbearing professor, limited theorist, heresiarch, bombastic preacher, adviser lacking practical sense.

M06.sintesi: is Hercules at the crossroads. A young man standing where two roads meet, arms folded, eyes lowered, urged on by an austere queen who promises moral satisfactions and by a bacchante who offers easy pleasures, while Cupid aims his arrow at his head. He shows the mechanism of the voluntary act: impression, deliberation, choice, action. He is the moral test that separates study from practice. His ultimate aim is to love until he exists only for others: man fulfils himself by loving as God does.
M06.parole: free will, choice, test, temptation, doubt, deliberation, desire, aspiration, vow, feeling, affections, sympathies, love, moral beauty; in the negative indecision, irresolution, weakness, sentimentality, broken promises, libertinism
M06.bene: voluntary determinism, choice, vow, aspirations, desires, examination, deliberation, responsibility, affections, sympathies.
M06.male: a test to be undergone, doubt, irresolution, dangerous temptation, the risk of being seduced, misconduct, libertinism, weakness, lack of heroism.
M06.astro: the double influence of Venus, or rather of Ishtar: a warrior as the morning star, a lover as the evening star.

M07.sintesi: the young victor who travels the world on a throne that is mobile yet cubic. He is the intellectual Soul (the Antimony of the alchemists) in which the thinking principle of the Magician, the willpower of the Emperor and the affection of the Lover are fused. He puts the Pope's doctrine into practice: he reconciles opposites, governs what is changeable and moody while remaining fixed like the sun, and drives the chariot forward by yoking together two opposing forces that on their own would cancel each other out.
M07.parole: triumph, victory, firmness, self-mastery, direction, government, talent, merit, honest diplomacy, conciliation, progress, civilisation, harmony
M07.bene: legitimate success, deserved advancement, talent, ability, aptitudes put to work, tact in governing, applied diplomacy, competent leadership, reconciliation of antagonisms, progress, mobility, journeys over land.
M07.male: unjustified ambitions, lack of talent, usurped position, illegitimate government, dictatorships, harmful concessions, dangerous opportunism, worries, trouble in leadership, overwork, feverish activity without rest.

M08.sintesi: Themis, ordering Nature, who receives the life given by the Emperor and administers it according to number and measure. She is the Empress come down into action: she has lost her wings, her features have hardened, she sits on a throne fixed to the ground. With the sword she triggers the inevitable reaction to every imbalance, with the scales she brings everything back into equilibrium. Without her nothing lives: beings exist only by virtue of the law they obey.
M08.parole: law, order, balance, living stability, regularity, method, logic, impartiality, immanent justice, consequences, vital rhythm, administration, conservation
M08.bene: stability, conservatism, organisation, normal functioning, law, discipline, adapting to necessities, moderate opinions, reason, administration, economy, obedience.
M08.male: bourgeois narrowness, submission to custom, lack of initiative, slavery to texts, a clerk's mentality, police, legal disputes, lawsuits, annoyances, exploitation by the people of the law.

M09.titolo: The sage who prepares the future
M09.sintesi: an experienced old man who knows the past and draws on it to prepare the future. He reconciles the impatience of the Chariot and the immobility of Justice: he moves slowly but without stopping, sounding the ground with a seven-knotted staff and lighting the way with a veiled lantern. He works in isolation, in secret, on the invisible weave of what is to be born: he is the Master at the drawing board, the hidden maker of future formations.
M09.parole: prudence, circumspection, experience, tradition, recollection, silence, discretion, isolation, concentration, continence, austerity, deep knowledge, medicine, secret gestation
M09.bene: isolation, concentration, silence, deepening, meditation, study, austerity, continence, sobriety, discretion; an experienced physician, an occultist who keeps his secrets.
M09.male: shyness, misanthropy, mutism, excessive circumspection, unsociability, a bearish character, avarice, poverty, celibacy, chastity, a shadowy conspirator.

M10.sintesi: the wheel with two concentric circles, inspired by Ezekiel's vision, is the double whirlwind that generates individual life: the individual is born by setting himself against the whole he comes from, and seizes a limited share of life from it, for a short time. The wheel turns fast in youth, slows down in maturity, stops in death. Hermanubis rises, the Typhonian monster goes down; above, motionless, the Sphinx guards the balance and the secret. In practice: luck, opportunities seized, success owed to circumstances, but unstable.
M10.parole: becoming, destiny, individual genesis, seed, fortune, opportunity, initiative, shrewdness, invention, chance discovery, ups and downs, inconstancy, passing benefits
M10.bene: fortune, an opportunity seized, invention and discovery, practical initiative, success favoured by fate, the maintenance of individual existence.
M10.male: instability, ups and downs, inconstancy, undeserved success bound to pass, passing benefits, ambition.

M11.sintesi: a fair and graceful queen who, with no apparent effort, tames a raging lion and holds its jaws open. This is not the strength of muscles but a feminine power, subtle and irresistible: Intelligence, the enchantress who reconciles rebellious energies without destroying them. She is the fulfilment of the active path: the Magician who has carried out his programme in full, and wears the same infinity-shaped hat, now crowned.
M11.parole: moral strength, self-mastery, courage, calm, fearlessness, psychic energy, intelligence that masters brutality, transformation of the instincts, work, effective action, discipline
M11.bene: power, a feasible idea, practical genius, intelligence that masters matter, courage, mastery, a man of action who overcomes difficulties, energy gathered and held in.
M11.male: impatience, anger, recklessness, boasting, brutality, cruelty; strength wasted at the wrong time.

M12.sintesi: with the Hanged Man we enter the passive, mystical, feminine or Ionic path. The fair young man of the Magician reappears bound, hanging by one ankle, powerless in body but serene, smiling. He has clung to an ideal too high to be realised in practice, renounces every personal interest and generously scatters the treasures he has gathered. He does not act with his muscles but through a psychic influence at a distance: like Perseus, invisible, he overcomes falsehood and frees the chained soul.
M12.parole: self-denial, voluntary sacrifice, forgetting oneself, disinterestedness, devotion, mysticism, apostolate, influence at a distance, generous dream, utopia, practical powerlessness
M12.bene: disinterestedness, self-forgetfulness, devotion, submission to duty, patriotism, generous dream, apostolate, philanthropy, gift of self, ideas of the future.
M12.male: good resolutions not carried out, projects not put into practice, well-conceived but theoretical plans, broken promises, unrequited love, good feelings exploited, inability to achieve, losses.

M13.sintesi: is the only arcanum with no written name: the image-makers of the Middle Ages seem to have refused to call "Death" what for them was not annihilation. Nothing is destroyed: everything changes form. Death dissolves worn-out forms and frees energies for new vital combinations; it does not kill, it brings back to life. For the initiate it is the central secret: knowing how to die, to one's state of imperfection, to prejudices, to one's own selfishness, in order to be reborn to a higher life.
M13.parole: transformation, renewal, inescapable necessity, liberation, dematerialisation, initiatory death, disillusion, lucidity, detachment, necessary end, inheritance, mourning, decomposition
M13.bene: deepening, intellectual penetration, metaphysics; disenchantment; severe discernment, disenchanted wisdom; detachment, resignation, stoicism.
M13.male: a fatal deadline; an inevitable failure not caused by the victim; discouragement, pessimism; absolute conversion; ending in order to start again in a diametrically opposite way.

M14.sintesi: death does not annihilate: it dissolves the container to free the contents, like a liquid poured endlessly from one mortal vessel into another without losing a drop. The winged spirit of Temperance pours this vital fluid from a silver urn into a golden one: it is the universal life that circulates among beings, the force that repairs, revives, heals. It asks for purity of soul, detachment, serenity.
M14.parole: universal life, circulation, vital fluid, healing, regeneration, serenity, moderation, adaptation, elasticity, impassivity, coolness, passivity
M14.bene: an accommodating character; a practical and fortunate philosophy; nonchalance; acceptance of events; elasticity, sociability, teachability; adaptive transformation.
M14.male: indifference; lack of personality; passive plasticity; inconstancy, changing moods; going along with the drift; submission to fashion and prejudice; results that fall short of aspirations; things taking their course.

M15.sintesi: universal life would circulate in peace, always the same, had the Serpent not driven every being to seize a share of it for itself. The Devil is radical selfishness, the differentiator, the Prince of the material world: without him nothing would take on a body. He is not an enemy to be cursed but an inferior to be governed: we owe him our physical life and the power to act outside ourselves, provided the will that commands him is pure.
M15.parole: soul of the world, astral light, instinct, lower unconscious, magic, magnetism, fascination, suggestion, passion, lust, disorder, overexcitement, demagogy, illicit means, selfishness
M15.bene: sexual attraction, passionate desires; magical action, magnetism, fluidic thaumaturgy; occult power, mysterious influences; an activity that makes one immune to sorcery, protection against sorcerers.
M15.male: turmoil, overexcitement; concupiscence, lewdness; complications, follies; intrigues, illicit means; fascination undergone, sorcery; slavery to the senses; a weakness that yields to deceptive influences; selfishness.

M16.sintesi: the Tower is the body, individual or social, built by the spirit that has identified itself with matter: a "House of God", that is, a building wrongly deified. Building is necessary and in keeping with the divine plan; but climbing too high, chasing chimerical ventures, claiming more than one can, draws down the lightning of Reason. What is unreasonable condemns itself to collapse.
M16.parole: materialisation, vital construction, pride, presumption, megalomania, hoarding, dogmatism, catastrophe, fall, collapse, punishment of excess; in a good sense: salutary fear, prudence, common sense
M16.bene: childbirth; a salutary crisis; distrust of oneself; a fear that turns one away from reckless ventures; benefit drawn from the mistakes of others; common sense, restraint, healthy timidity; attachment to pious observances; religious materialism.
M16.male: illness; a fault punished; catastrophe through imprudence; clandestine motherhood; scandal; hypocrisy unmasked; excess, abuse, hoarding; presumption, pride; chimerical ventures; deceptive alchemy.

M17.sintesi: cut off from the life of the Great Being by a thirst for autonomy, we have fallen into a deep night; but if we raise our eyes we see the stars shining: we are not abandoned, the gods keep watch and a programme has been traced for each of us. The naked young woman pouring two inexhaustible vases is earthly life in its loveliest aspect: Ishtar, beautiful and merciful Nature, who makes the prison of the body bearable and even paradisal. This is the arcanum of hope, of beauty, of destiny accepted, of the sleep that brings counsel.
M17.parole: hope, destiny, predestination, beauty, aesthetics, poetry, nature, consolation, immortality, sleep and dreams, presentiments, astrology, innocence, naivety, sensuality, fatalism
M17.bene: candour; surrender to healthy influences; naturism; trust in destiny; aesthetic flowering; poetic sensitivity; presentiments; kindness, compassion.
M17.male: dissoluteness, immodesty, loose conduct; lack of spontaneity; artificial constraint contrary to health; daydreaming, romanticism; a mind turned away from practical life.

M18.sintesi: borrowed light that only half illuminates. It is imagination left to itself, which makes the subjective objective and builds theories on illusory contrasts; but it is also the obligatory school of trials: the bloodstained path of earthly life which, through falls and deceptions, leads to the discernment of error and to the dawn of the Sun. Whoever goes through it without being fooled learns no longer to be the plaything of their own phantasmagorias.
M18.parole: imagination, appearances, illusion, sensory world, Maya, superstition, credulity, visionary fancies, passive clairvoyance, imposed labour, trial, hidden dangers, deception, journeys over water
M18.bene: objectivity, the sensory world, experimentation, work; the laborious conquest of truth, learning through pain; the imposed task, irksome but necessary work; passive clairvoyance, lucidity; navigation.
M18.male: errors of the senses, false assumptions, snares, traps, deceptions; misleading theories, fanciful knowledge, visionary fancies; flattery, threats, blunders; a journey; whims, moodiness.

M19.sintesi: after the trials of the Moon, the light that shows things as they are, unveiled. The Sun shines impartially for all: those who have removed the obstacles between themselves and the light benefit most. Two young people embracing in a flowered circle, protected by a wall, are the soul wedding the spirit and regenerated humanity finding paradise again: not the Eden of passive innocence, but the industrious one of fraternal civilisation, of beloved work and of art.
M19.parole: light, reason, truth, discernment, clarity, fraternity, harmony, peace, marriage, art, poetry, generosity, shared happiness, glory; in shadow vanity, appearance, misunderstood artist
M19.bene: clear discernment, clarity of judgement and expression, literary or artistic talent; pacification, harmony, understanding, conjugal happiness, fraternity; the reign of intelligence and good feelings; reputation, glory, fame.
M19.male: dazzlement, vanity, posing, exhibitionism, self-love, touchiness; misunderstood artist; poverty hidden under brilliant appearances, bluff, deceptive appearance, a façade that pretends, a prestigious stage set.

M20.sintesi: the light of the Sun stops at the surface; Judgement penetrates the essence, distinguishes spirit from matter, the living word from the dead letter. The angel sounds the trumpet and the dead rise, but in spirit: it is the awakening of forgotten truths and of tradition, the breath of the Holy Spirit that makes minds fruitful, the second birth that turns the disciple into a Master. The truly dead are we ourselves, shut in the tomb of individual life.
M20.parole: inspiration, awakening, spiritual resurrection, Holy Spirit, tradition rediscovered, esotericism, enthusiasm, prophecy, genius, healing, rebirth, renown; in shadow exaltation, noise, empty propaganda
M20.bene: enthusiasm, exaltation of the soul, spirituality, prophecy, holiness, theurgy, miraculous medicine; resurrection of the past, renewal, birth; propaganda, apostolate.
M20.male: spiritual exhaustion, mental intoxication, overheated illuminism; the firebrand who stirs up crowds; the conjurer who gives ghosts substance; publicity, noise, agitation from which nothing comes.

M21.sintesi: 21 = 3 × 7, the supreme synthesis of the Tarot: all that is manifest, the result of permanent creative action. The World is a whirlwind in which nothing stops; at its centre, the goddess of life runs without pause within the garland and, precisely by running, stays still, fixed like the Pole Star at the centre of the celestial rotation. It is the Great Work accomplished, the Temple built, the Gnosis and ecstasy of one who sees the One Thing beyond appearances.
M21.parole: totality, cosmos, fulfilment, crowning, reward, reintegration, perfection, ecstasy, integral science, Fortuna Major, complete success; in shadow insurmountable obstacle, hostile surroundings, dispersion
M21.bene: Fortuna Major, complete success, the crowning of the work, fulfilment; decisive intervention, highly favourable circumstances, propitious surroundings; absolute integrity; contemplative absorption, ecstasy.
M21.male: a formidable obstacle, hostile surroundings, setbacks; worldliness, dispersion, distraction, lack of application and concentration; a severe reversal of fortune, ruin; little social esteem.
